options.name: clone
options.description: If V(false), do not clone the repository if it does not exist locally.

options.name: dest
options.description: Absolute path of where the repository should be cloned to. This parameter is required, unless clone and update are set to no.

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to C(hg) executable to use. If not supplied, the normal mechanism for resolving binary paths is used.

options.name: force
options.description: Discards uncommitted changes. Runs C(hg update -C).

options.name: purge
options.description: Deletes untracked files. Runs C(hg purge).

options.name: revision
options.description: Equivalent C(-r) option in hg command which could be the changeset, revision number, branch name or even tag.

options.name: update
options.description: If V(false), do not retrieve new revisions from the origin repository.
